cases.sentence: (Другие мертвые не ожили, пока не окончилась тысяча лет.) Это ___ .
cases.explain: «первое воскресение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

cases.sentence: Блажен и свят тот, кто участвует в ___.
cases.explain: «первом воскресении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

cases.sentence: Они прошли маршем по всей земле и окружили стан народа Божьего — Его ___ .
cases.explain: «любимый город» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war; the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

cases.sentence: Они стояли перед троном и перед ___.
cases.explain: «раскрытыми книгами» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

cases.explain: «Огненное озеро» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
